uiVerification.summary: Real Editor headless geometry red→green: wrapped replacement comparison follows clicked character/line, same-ID pointer changes,20px document scroll, keyboard visible-line fallback and viewport clamps. Existing exact replacement/cancel/reapply/resolve/undo/draft and English switching browser cases remain green; no GUI/shared client build. acceptanceCriteria: User method annual forecasts accept2026年度/2026财年/FY2026/26E as the same explicit2026 year, with the original security/cutoff/unit/unique quote gates. C1–C4 math, actual source access and authorization are unchanged.

Clearly reported/actual or explicitly non-forecast metrics never trigger consensus queries or a false incomplete-forecast receipt. Adjacent actual2025 and explicit2026 forecasts remain separate; source-evidence prefixes such as reported orders do not negate an explicit following forecast. First FY shorthand, same-year EPS/profit continuations and an immediate preposed forecast clause are preserved.

Extraction and incomplete-forecast gating use the same forecast scopes. Missing units, incompatible period/basis and an unparsed later year remainpartial; another parsed forecast cannot provide their completion receipt. Added method delta does not overwrite historical native or failure evidence.

Replacement comparison clicks store an ephemeral Yjs relative character anchor. The bubble selects that wrapped line fragment and recalculates actual coordinates on scroll/resize; clicking the same highlight on another line repositions it. Keyboard activation uses visible highlight fragments. It does not write the body, review records or user drafts.

Existing exact replacement/cancel/reapply/automatic resolution/native undo and English fixed chrome are preserved. English localization test now compares requests before/after comparison-language interactions rather than wrongly requiring zero after a legitimate immediate tier-change review.
risks: Forecast extraction remains a bounded lexical parser, not general financial natural-language understanding; missing year/basis/unit, repeated ambiguous quote or contradictory clauses are not filled by guessing.
No fresh infodb/model/native-client call was made for these fixes. Source-controlled direct tests and headless Editor geometry require root integration/native acceptance.

The unrelated memory-English UI test has a stale response mock without rows and fails identically on clean8db; it is explicitly skipped in this handoff and was not modified. Baseline evidence is output/notes-forecast-scope-1023/baseline-8db-memory-english-ui.log.

acceptanceCriteria: Host canonical timestamps require bounded scanning of business source references and deep equality to actually observed sourceRecords. Optional display formatting prose is not treated as source evidence; detail recovery supports a unique real selector and its existing bounded row scope. Arbitrary expressions/scripts are not executed.
